# Commands

<!-- generated by cypera gen cli — regenerate, don't hand-edit -->

## `cypera gen crate-map`

Workspace `Cargo.toml`s → crate/layer/purpose table (+ per-crate
module sections when entry files exist).

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--repo <REPO>` | Repo root (dir containing the workspace `Cargo.toml`). Default: `.` — upward discovery is intentionally not done |
| `--out <OUT>` | Write to this file instead of stdout. An existing file with a `<!-- crate-map -->` marker gets only the table after the marker replaced |
| `--layer <LAYERS>` | Layer override `crate-name=layer` (repeatable) — overrides the `-core`/`-cli`/bare-name heuristic |

## `cypera gen cli`

Wrap `gen-cli-docs` output (clap-markdown markdown) in a reference
page.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--input <INPUT>` | `gen-cli-docs` markdown file, or `-` for stdin. Default: `-` |
| `--title <TITLE>` | Page title. Default: `Commands` |
| `--out <OUT>` | Write to this file instead of stdout |

## `cypera gen config`

Scan Rust sources for `pub struct` doc comments → field tables.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--file <FILES>` | Rust source file to scan (repeatable, required) |
| `--only <ONLY>` | Only document these struct names (repeatable). Default: every `pub struct` found |
| `--title <TITLE>` | Page title. Default: `Config reference` |
| `--out <OUT>` | Write to this file instead of stdout |

Global: `cypera --help`, `cypera --version`.
